citations.assessment: The digital edition uses bracketed Shimon before Shezuri and names a second Shimon. The Mishnah parallel writes Shimon Shezuri. Preserve the received variant as reported.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The Tosefta chapter gives a distinct pairing of Yishmael and Shimon Shezuri. The exact comparison is 5:7. This does not itself prove a scribal error in the Yerushalmi.
The reciprocal explicitly discusses both the conjectured correction and the possibility of a different bearer of the name.
